notes: New: Low data mode, in the Updates tab. NovaPanel reaches the internet for two things - checking for a new version, and your weather. Turn this on and it checks for a version once a month, on the same date every month, and slows weather to…

It also stops the app looking up your location by itself. Normally, if you have not set a town, NovaPanel asks a location service where you are. In Low data mode it never does that on its own - only when you press Detect.
The setting shows you exactly what it changed: what goes out, how often, and the date of your next check-in. Checking for updates by hand still works immediately, whichever way the switch is set.
Removed: the suggestion to install HWiNFO64 from the graphics card row in System Scan. That advice was out of date.
